inference.method: paired item percentile bootstrap; central 90% and 95% intervals
inference.scope: 100 fixed authored items (50 fact, 50 context); eight fixed panels
inference.warning: No population, simultaneous-coverage or exact-equality claim; constant observed differences produce degenerate bootstrap intervals.

rule.precision_scope: all 100 trials per arm; parent-qualified per-position gate
